# Novelty-Depth Template

| Idea | What appears new? | What is structurally new? | What remains unchanged? | Novelty depth | Action |
|---|---|---|---|---:|---|
| [Idea] | [Surface novelty] | [Frame / mechanism / system / institution] | [Old assumptions] | [0-1] | [Action] |

## Review questions

- Is this new language around an old logic?
- Does it change a mechanism or only a surface?
- Does it create a new option space?
